basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old IT technician based in Ottawa, Canada. I have a passion for tabletop role-playing games, especially Dungeons & Dragons 5e, which I've been playing for over 3 years. Outside of gaming, I enjoy collecting vinyl records and am a proud owner of an Audi TT. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work and during weekends. Currently single, I enjoy spending my free time exploring new game mechanics and storylines.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a strong background in information technology, with a degree in Computer Science from Carleton University. I've also self-taught myself various programming languages and have a deep interest in automotive technology. My experience with D&D stems from years of playing and DMing in various online communities.
behavioral_pattern.relationship_with_community_policies: strict; I always make sure to follow both subreddit and site-wide rules to maintain a positive reputation in the community.
